versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Corvid crime family that borrows gold now and pays interest later; ravens turn every coin paid into stats.
Hold debt to fuel Collect, or clear it for payouts; winners and other tribes' units pay your debts for you.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Rules fixes only: Skim now counts as the loser paying (Collect fires per gold), Memorys don't stack, no pawning on a full Ledger.
Clearer wording for the Oast Clerk, Wassail Warden, Grandmother Corbie's full amount and the Jackdaw's feather, so every card reads one way.

stop_reason: 3 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
